sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the unconditional pre-2007 dry-docking constraint: it incorrectly requires every pre-1 July 2007 ship to provide a qualifying docking date even when the draught condition is false or the required markings are already present. Encode the old-ship branch so that, only when summer fresh-water draught exceeds UIWL and either marking is absent, the ship must have a first scheduled dry-docking date after 1 July 2007 that has not yet passed; otherwise report the missing markings after the deadline. Also represent and validate that the ice-class draught mark is positioned at the maximum permissible ice-class draught amidships, rather than checking presence alone; locate the canonical property for that mark value/position via the variable matcher.
